summary: Unknown-total (None) Progress tasks are implemented. Not verified: black was not available in the venv, so formatting was matched by hand. tests/test_pretty.py fails at collection because the venv lacks the attr module. About 12-13 tests in test_syntax, test_markdown, test_card and test_traceback fail intermittently, and they also fail on the unmodified baseline. Nothing is committed.
